summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on the phase-39 branch (PR #423), then merge main into the branch to pick up changes from the previously merged PR #422.
summary.outcome: All 7 Copilot review threads triaged and addressed (5 fixes, 1 not-applicable, 1 doc fix); new unit tests added for deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair; merge conflicts from main resolved; all 142 crypto tests passing with typecheck clean.

repo: The vault settings IPNS keypair derivation function (deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair) had no unit tests prior to this session.

PR #422 (phase-38 work) removed a circular @cipherbox/core dependency from vault-ipns.test.ts using inline test vectors; that fix was not yet on the phase-39 branch, causing pre-existing test failures.
TEE key enrollment follows the StorageTab.tsx pattern and must be performed before createAndPublishIpnsRecord when saving vault settings.
STATE.md is manually maintained and gets overwritten to main's state during a merge — must be manually restored to reflect the active phase.
ROADMAP.md checkbox state ([x] vs [ ]) diverged between branch and main, requiring conflict resolution in favor of the branch's checked entries.

code.finding: retentionDays validation was blocking 0 as a valid value; 0 should be allowed per spec D-03 (no retention / immediate expiry).
TEE key wrapping was missing before createAndPublishIpnsRecord; must follow same enrollment pattern as StorageTab.

retentionDays was sourced inconsistently; should come from vault-settings store. Main also refactored purgeExpired to use getSdkClient().purgeExpired() — both changes needed to be reconciled during merge.
setTimeout in save handler was not cleaned up on unmount, causing a potential state-update-after-unmount leak; fixed with a ref + cleanup in useEffect.
New standalone test file for deriveVaultSettingsIpnsKeypair; isolated from vault-ipns.test.ts to avoid the (now-resolved) @cipherbox/core circular dep issue.

workflow: When a sibling branch has a critical fix (circular dep removal) not yet merged into the working branch, create a separate test file to avoid the broken import rather than waiting for the merge.
Use git stash before merging main when there are uncommitted in-flight changes to avoid losing work during conflict resolution.
pnpm lint:fix was run manually by the user mid-session after commits — consider integrating into the pre-commit workflow.
GraphQL reviewThreads API is the correct way to fetch unresolved PR threads; REST comments endpoint does not expose resolution status.

friction: Pre-existing @cipherbox/core circular dependency in vault-ipns.test.ts caused test failures unrelated to the session's changes, requiring investigation before the root cause (missing cherry-pick from phase-38 branch) was identified.
The fix commit (560c871fe) from phase-38 branch was not on phase-39, requiring the test file to be manually rewritten rather than simply running the existing suite.
Merging main overwrote STATE.md with phase-38 state, requiring a manual fix to restore phase-39 progress tracking.
User interrupted the commit step to run pnpm lint:fix manually, suggesting lint was not wired into the pre-commit hook or was forgotten in the workflow.

useBin.ts conflict was non-trivial: the PR fix (source from vault settings store) had to be reconciled with main's unrelated SDK refactor (getSdkClient().purgeExpired()), requiring careful manual merge.
open_items: VaultTab.tsx preset configurations (thread 5) were explicitly deferred as a deliberate simplification — presets are not yet implemented.

vault-ipns.test.ts still contains the pre-existing initializeVault and deriveRegistryIpnsKeypair tests that previously depended on @cipherbox/core; verify these are fully correct after the inline test-vector rewrite.
